name: POPR 5302
title: Policy Practice: Advanced Processes, Careers, and Contexts
description: This capstone course fosters integration of knowledge, values, and skills to advance policy work at local, state, and federal levels. Students will be expected to demonstrate an ability to synthesize and critically evaluate their policy practice skills; identify personal and professional values; assess political contexts; and develop policy goals that advance equitable access and outcomes. Students build professional practice portfolios and engage in career planning. Required course for students in the Policy Practice concentration.
